notes.title: Food Delivery Simulator Beta 0.1.0 Has Released!
notes.content:
[h3]Early Access now available![/h3]

We are officially in Beta! After many tireless days of working on FDS, we have finally published it for you to try out! Unfortunately, Beta means some things may not be finished and bugs may be encountered in the current build.

Please make use of the "Bug Report" button in the game's main menu to report bugs directly to us with relevant image/video URLs to help us detect and fix them quickly. You may also leave suggestions using this box. All suggestions/reports will be looked at and taken into consideration.

For the next few weeks, we will carefully monitor the user feedback and our Discord to take immediate action on any game-breaking bugs or missing features and resolve them ASAP. We want you to have the best experience possible and we will work hard to bring that throughout the early access phase.

notes.title: Food Delivery Simulator Beta 0.1.0 Is Releasing Soon
notes.content:
[h3]We are very grateful for the patience and anticipation of all of you who have been waiting to play Food Delivery Simulator. It was planned to be released on December 5th. However, the first build we sent for review to Steam two weeks ago had some issues, which have been fixed, and we are now awaiting their approval of our release.

We will release Beta 0.1.0 with a 10% launch discount in the coming days.[/h3]

[b]After release, we will closely monitor all user feedback via bug reporting and suggestions on Discord. We will rapidly implement fixes and additions throughout December to make sure the game is satisfactory enough 😊[/b]

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/BZJqqUmgrY]Join our Discord[/url][/h2]
